title: Error analysis of penalized $H({\rm div})$-conforming finite element methods for surface Stokes problems
summary: In recent years a number of finite element methods have been developed for the surface Stokes equations. Constructing standard conforming surface finite element methods for the velocity-pressure formulation of this problem would require simultaneously enforcing $H^1$ conformity and tangentiality of the velocity field, which is not possible on the generalized polyhedral approximating surfaces on which surface FEM are typically posed.
